name: upi-autopay-review
title: UPI AutoPay Review
description: Pre-approval review of a UPI AutoPay mandate: cap, schedule, validity and merchant read back against the plan, flagging a cap far above the price, "as presented" schedules, no end date, the wrong merchant and debits above the PIN-free limit, with one-tap fixes.

meta.summary: Reads a UPI AutoPay mandate back against the plan before the PIN, flagging a cap far above the price, no end date or the wrong merchant.
meta.server: The PSP/bank enforces mandate terms; your server should create mandates with the plan's real cap and validity and verify them after registration.
catches: A cap far above the plan price (capRatio)
No end date or 30+ year validity
Merchant name that doesn't match the plan
limits: Format and consistency checks only; it does not register or validate the mandate with NPCI or the bank
Merchant match compares names you pass
The ₹15,000 limit is the general case; some categories have ₹1,00,000
a11y: Mandate terms in a <dl>; warnings summarised and linked via aria-describedby
After a fix, focus moves to the next fix or Approve
Approve uses aria-disabled while pending; status is role=status

rules.note: Confirmed: every mandate specifies a validity period the customer can modify or withdraw; issuer pre-debit notice at least 24 hours before; opt-out of a debit; AFA above ₹15,000 (₹1,00,000 for insurance, mutual funds, credit card bills). Informational; check the official source.
